3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: On the banks of the Zpana River in Bronaz stood Palas Verana.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Almost as opulent as my own palace, it had once served as a summer residence for my ancestors, the Rubaz family.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Today it was the home of Russello "Rusty" Montoro. The CEO of Rizian Royal Gold, and the wealthiest commoner in the country.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: I stepped out onto the deck of the Rizania as the yacht approached the palace's private dock. Hugo and Elena were already there, gazing out at the grounds.

7.speaker: Hugo Toras
7.text: "I can't believe what I'm seeing. Palas Verana without its water garden is no palace at all."

8.speaker: Elena Werner
8.text: "I think it's an improvement, myself. But what do you make of this, Your Majesty?"

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: I looked in the direction she was indicating. The water garden, once a tranquil oasis filled with blossoming flowers and gently burbling fountains, had been replaced with a gigantic gold-tiled swimming pool.

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Seems practical. I never understood the appeal of water gardens anyway."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "Why don't we have one of these at Palas Rezna?"

14.speaker: Elena Werner
14.text: "They're attractive, to be sure. But at the height of summer, looking at fountains you can't swim in is just torturous."

15.speaker: Hugo Toras
15.text: "I'd be surprised if Mr. Montoro even used it."

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: The gold magnate's red hair was streaked with grey, but his eyes had a youthful mischief about them.

17.speaker: Russello Montoro
17.text: "On behalf of all of us at the esteemed Rizian Royal Gold corporation, I do hereby extend my cordial greetings to your royal delegation..."

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: He trailed off with a grin.

19.speaker: Russello Montoro
19.text: "Heck, I was never one for formalities. Welcome to my palace, Your Majesty."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "You certainly have made it yours, haven't you?"

23.speaker: Russello Montoro
23.text: "Oh, the pool? I can't stand swimming myself. Get sunburned at the drop of a hat. The grandkids love it, though."

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: He turned to Hugo and Elena.

25.speaker: Russello Montoro
25.text: "Your Grace, Madam Treasurer. Haven't had a sit-down with you two since the last gentleman wore the crown."

26.speaker: Hugo Toras
26.text: "You must mean my honorable brother, His Majesty King Valero. May he rest in peace."

28.speaker: Elena Werner
28.text: "Now, Hugo. Rusty paid his respects at the funeral like everyone else."

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: She shook Rusty's hand. He beckoned for us to sit as his valets brought over water and fresh fruit.

30.speaker: Russello Montoro
30.text: "Rusty, please. Calling me 'Mr. Montoro' is like trying to put an elevator in an outhouse."

31.speaker: Russello Montoro
31.text: "Now. As you know, Rizian Royal Gold boasts a long, proud history of cooperation with the Crown."

32.speaker: Russello Montoro
32.text: "That deal was your father's idea, Your Majesty. All I was asking for was fair compensation for what my company lost. As any CEO would."

33.speaker: Russello Montoro
33.text: "My point being. As a trusted business associate, there's something I need to bring to your attention."

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: He picked up a piece of paper from the table next to him. It was a flyer with a few sentences written in both Rizian and Wehzek.

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "The first female Prime Minister of Morella. A pioneer."

39.speaker: Russello Montoro
39.text: "A pioneering pain in both of our behinds."

40.speaker: Russello Montoro
40.text: "Right, Your Majesty. Banning propaganda in Rizia won't stop what's happening on her side of the border."

41.speaker: Russello Montoro
41.text: "Woman's never picked up a chisel in her life, and she suddenly knows how to run the MITZ."

46.speaker: Russello Montoro
46.text: "She wouldn't be if she stuck to governing Morella. You know, like she was elected to do."

47.speaker: Russello Montoro
47.text: "Supervisors at my mines have gotten word that the workers are holding after-hours meetings. On the subject of 'unsafe conditions'."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "Have you tried, let's see, improving those conditions?"

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "They should be grateful to be employed at all."

51.speaker: Russello Montoro
51.text: "Don't know if I'd go that far. But the more employees put their heads together, the more dangerous their ideas get."

52.speaker: Russello Montoro
52.text: "They were before. Someone's been putting ideas in their heads."

53.speaker: Russello Montoro
53.text: "I mean, we would if they brought up the subject with us directly. But seems they'd rather conspire amongst themselves."

54.speaker: Elena Werner
54.text: "Have there been any accidents lately? Anything that might have triggered this?"

56.speaker: Russello Montoro
56.text: "Accidents have been part of this job since the dawn of time. Used to say you weren't a real miner until you were missing a finger."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "What do you need all ten of them for, anyway?"

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "Did you ever even work in the mines yourself, Rusty?"

60.speaker: Russello Montoro
60.text: "As long as you've got enough to swing a pickaxe."

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: Rusty slowly held up his left hand. His little finger had been lopped off at the second joint.

62.speaker: Russello Montoro
62.text: "That's reality. Not all of us have estates to live off, you know."

64.speaker: Hugo Toras
64.text: "Do you have a request of His Majesty, Mr. Montoro? Or have you merely invited us here to complain?"

66.speaker: Russello Montoro
66.text: "If I'm right, they're about to propose a big new batch of workplace regulations. Not just for RRG, but for everyone."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "How much revenue would RRG stand to lose?"
67.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Revenue"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_GuestWorkers"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_ITZ"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Zille"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Revenue"] == true) == false)

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "We still have the Meftiem International Trade Zone, don't we? The rules wouldn't apply there."
68.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_ITZ"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_GuestWorkers"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_ITZ"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Zille"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Revenue"] == true) == false)

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "The company will rebound when we get Zille back."
69.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Zille"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_GuestWorkers"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_ITZ"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Zille"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Revenue"] == true) == false)

70.speaker: Russello Montoro
70.text: "Hard to say. Implementing the regulations themselves would cost a pretty penny."

71.speaker: Russello Montoro
71.text: "And what do you think will happen if we pass those costs on to our trading partners? They'll hit the road faster than my first ex-wife."

73.speaker: Russello Montoro
73.text: "Sure, RRG isn't a direct stakeholder in the Trade Zone. But we're involved enough to be highly worried about Alma Saltana."

76.speaker: Elena Werner
76.text: "We have been seeing more global competition on the gold market, unfortunately."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "Aren't most RRG miners labor hands from foreign countries? Would the regulations even apply to them?"
77.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_GuestWorkers"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_GuestWorkers"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_ITZ"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Zille"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Revenue"] == true) == false)

78.speaker: Elena Werner
78.text: "Morella doesn't have unilateral power over the International Trade Zone. Rizia, Lespia and Valgsland all have a say."

79.speaker: Russello Montoro
79.text: "And guess which one of those Ms. Saltana has been cozying up to on this subject?"

80.speaker: Russello Montoro
80.text: "If she and Hegel get their way, Rizia will either lose its mining rights or our boys will have to pray to Malenyev before going to work every morning."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "She should have the right to determine how gold is mined in her own country."

85.speaker: Russello Montoro
85.text: "They most certainly would, now that labor hands have the same protections as honest-to-goodness Rizians."

86.speaker: Russello Montoro
86.text: "25 years ago, that little nub of land was home to some of the fattest gold veins my company's ever found. But Nur knows what shape it's in now."

87.speaker: Hugo Toras
87.text: "It's Chancellor Hegel's influence that is concerning. Malenyevism has a way of spilling over borders."

88.speaker: Elena Werner
88.text: "It's hard to say if we can count on Lespia's cooperation. Of course they abhor Valgsland, but we don't have the friendliest history with them either."

89.speaker: Hugo Toras
89.text: "Another reason to keep his influence far from our borders."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "No matter what, our revenue from the region takes a hit."

91.speaker: Hugo Toras
91.text: "And the CSP will claim another victory."

92.speaker: Elena Werner
92.text: "The political aspect isn't as concerning to me as the loss of access to our most important mines. We have to keep a close eye on this."

93.speaker: Russello Montoro
93.text: "She's started calling for regulation over there as well. Or worse, nationalization."

94.speaker: Elena Werner
94.text: "We'll have to keep a close eye on this."

95.speaker: Russello Montoro
95.text: "Honestly, Your Majesty, I just about ate my boot when you made that decree."

96.speaker: Russello Montoro
96.text: "My fellow businessmen and I lost enough money granting all kinds of benefits to folks who don't even understand how lucky they are to work here. Giving them more would damn near bankrupt us."

98.speaker: Elena Werner
98.text: "I agree we shouldn't impose more regulations than necessary, but investing in safer and healthier employees could lead to profit in the long term. Foreigners included."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "It has indeed been a mutually beneficial partnership. I intend to keep it that way."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Was it 'cooperation' when you wrested away a third of the kingdom's stake?"

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "Don't overinflate your company's importance. We have other resources."

103.speaker: Russello Montoro
103.text: "But only one is in the name of the national anthem."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "I suppose you haven't invited us over here to marvel at your renovations."

108.speaker: Russello Montoro
108.text: "I couldn't help noticing you've been crisscrossing the kingdom lately. And no royal tour would be complete without a visit to my modest little hideaway."

109.speaker: Russello Montoro
109.text: "A shame Her Highness couldn't make it. Too occupied with her latest beau?"

110.speaker: Hugo Toras
110.text: "One dance does not a 'beau' make. We'd appreciate it if you didn't speculate about Princess Vina's romantic prospects."

111.speaker: Russello Montoro
111.text: "We'll get to that, Your Majesty. Settle down, have a drink first."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "Please tell me what this meeting is about. We don't have all day."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "That's quite all right, Hugo. My daughter does happen to have her eye on a special someone."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "Agreed. My daughter is a private person and her love life is strictly off-limits."

115.speaker: Russello Montoro
115.text: "Lucky man. Anyway, I'll cut to the chase."

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: He sat back and unbuttoned the top button of his shirt.

118.speaker: Elena Werner
118.text: "But for now, our product is of high enough quality that Rumburg is willing to pay more for it."

119.speaker: Hugo Toras
119.text: "Yes, but if the price rises further still? I'd rather not admit it, but Mr. Montoro may have a point."

133.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
133.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_GuestWorkers"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_ITZ"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Zille"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Revenue"] == true

134.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
134.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_GuestWorkers"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_ITZ"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Zille"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Revenue"] == true) == false

143.speaker: Russello Montoro
143.text: "Look, I won't press the issue any further. Just hope you'll do the right thing if this ever lands in your lap."

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: Rusty took a big bite out of a watermelon slice. He wiped the juice off his chin.
144.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_GuestWorkers"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_ITZ"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Zille"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn03_RustyConvo_Revenue"] == true

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: Elena pushed her chair back and stood up.

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "An increased stake in RRG in exchange for refusing regulations? If I didn't know better, I'd think you were trying to bribe the government."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "If the company's in as much trouble as you mentioned, it's no wonder you're so eager to sell us our stake back."

148.speaker: Russello Montoro
148.text: "Who knows? If all goes well, I might be persuaded to sell you back the share the honorable King Valero sold me."

149.speaker: Russello Montoro
149.text: "Your Majesty. How crass do you think I am?"

150.speaker: Russello Montoro
150.text: "You misunderstand me, Your Majesty. We're not in trouble. Yet."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "Let me make one thing clear, *Russello*. You are only running RRG by the grace of Rizia's royal family. Everything you have, we can take away."

152.speaker: Elena Werner
152.text: "I'm going to recuse myself from this part of the conversation. Where's the ladies' room?"

153.speaker: Russello Montoro
153.text: "Just inside. If you've never sat on a solid gold toilet, you're in for a treat."

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: A valet escorted Elena out. Hugo, Rusty and I glanced at each other.

155.speaker: Hugo Toras
155.text: "I think our friend *Rusty* here is perilously close to oversteppng his bounds."

157.speaker: Hugo Toras
157.text: "But cooperation with RRG served King Valero well in the past. Even after selling part of the royal stake."

158.speaker: Narrator
158.text: Elena stepped back onto the terrace.

159.speaker: Elena Werner
159.text: "That was... colder than I expected. I hope I haven't missed much?"

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: Hugo practically sprang from his seat.

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "What do you think of all this, Hugo?"

162.speaker: Russello Montoro
162.text: "You're a smart man, Your Grace. You and I should go out for beers someday."

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: Hugo looked like he'd swallowed something unpleasant.

164.speaker: Hugo Toras
164.text: "It's been a delight, but we must be headed back to Porte Drazon."

165.speaker: Russello Montoro
165.text: "And here I was about to ask you to stay for lunch. So soon, Your Majesty?"

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Yes, I think we're just about finished here."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "Don't worry. You'll be hearing from me."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "Please excuse my uncle's hastiness. Lunch would be lovely."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "Remind me. How did a man like him take over the most powerful corporation in Rizia?"

170.speaker: Elena Werner
170.text: "He's got a knack for being in the right place at the right time."

171.speaker: Hugo Toras
171.text: "Legend has it he worked his way up from regional mine supervisor in a series of backroom deals and boardroom betrayals."

172.speaker: Russello Montoro
172.text: "This is about more than just a few disgruntled miners. Rumor has it the RPP's picking up the cause."

174.speaker: Russello Montoro
174.text: "Sorry, Your Grace. Got to pretend to be civil to me a while longer."

175.speaker: Russello Montoro
175.text: "That we are. Enjoy the trip back."

179.speaker: Russello Montoro
179.text: "Far from it, if you ask me. But enjoy the trip back."

180.speaker: Russello Montoro
180.text: "Not if you hear from me first, eh?"

184.speaker: Narrator
184.text: I could see him cheerfully waving from the veranda as Hugo, Elena and I stepped back on board the yacht.

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: Hugo and Elena sat back down as the valets began bringing out our midday meal.

189.speaker: Russello Montoro
189.text: "A shame Her Highness couldn't make it. Has she finally found a beau back home in the capital?"

190.speaker: Hugo Toras
190.text: "We'll thank you not to speculate about Princess Vina's romantic prospects."

191.speaker: Russello Montoro
191.text: "Well, all right. I'll cut to the chase, then."

198.speaker: Russello Montoro
198.text: "They're fixing to have it that way, yes."

199.speaker: Russello Montoro
199.text: "The folks pushing for these restrictions -- I mean regulations -- are a mix of labor hands and honest-to-goodness Rizians. With some support from the Sazons to boot."

200.speaker: Russello Montoro
200.text: "I see what they're going for. I really do. But giving them everything they want would set a dangerous example."

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: Suddenly, a group of armed men exited the palace in single file. They positioned themself at equal intervals around the dock.

204.speaker: Narrator
204.text: They followed us with their eyes as we disembarked and walked towards the palace veranda.

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "What's your rank? Where did you serve?"

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "You will bow before your king, you insolent lowlife."

212.speaker: Narrator
212.text: He didn't move a muscle. There was a rustle behind me as Titus shifted his weight, on high alert.

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: He stared at me with a look of non-comprehension. There was a rustle behind me as Titus shifted his weight, on high alert.

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: He stared at me with a look of non-comprehension. There was a rustle behind me as Titus shifted his weight, on high alert.

216.speaker: Narrator
216.text: Rusty rose from where he'd been sitting and rushed over to us.

217.speaker: Russello Montoro
217.text: "Antoine! That's no way to treat our royal visitors."

218.speaker: Narrator
218.text: The guard reluctantly bowed and stepped aside. Rusty ushered us past him, shaking his head as he did so.

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "You say I'm welcome. Your guards send a different message."

220.speaker: Russello Montoro
220.text: "I know what it seems like, but they're looking out for your safety as well as mine. Can't be too careful after what happened in Wehlen."

221.speaker: Narrator
221.text: As I passed the largest guard, I noticed he was wearing a badge that read 'Palantor Security Solutions.'"

223.speaker: Russello Montoro
223.text: "There you go! With your father, it was always 'Russello' this and 'Mr. Montoro' that."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "Let me say this straight away. Your wealth may excuse your lack of manners in some circles, but not with me."

226.speaker: Russello Montoro
226.text: "I do beg your pardon. I never did have time for fancy etiquette classes."

227.speaker: Narrator
227.text: Elena struggled to keep a pleasant expression on her face.

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "It was the Crown's to begin with. Queen Lyza never should have privatized it."

229.speaker: Russello Montoro
229.text: "Your grandmother was a savvy dame. She saw an innovator and reached out her hand, 'stead of her fist."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "That's troubling. Workers in this country should have a right to safety."

231.speaker: Russello Montoro
231.text: "They already do, Your Majesty. Someone's been stirring up trouble."

232.speaker: Russello Montoro
232.text: "First week on the job in Argno. Thought I'd save time by fixing a blockage in one of the ore processors. Reached right in, and wouldn't you know? It started working again."

233.speaker: Russello Montoro
233.text: "But did I blame RRG for my own boneheaded stupidity? Your Majesty, I did not."

234.speaker: Russello Montoro
234.text: "Duke Hugo, why don't you show her the way? Maybe have a gander at my latest art acquisitions while you're at it."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "I'm sure Ms. Werner can find her own way."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "Go on, Hugo. I'll be fine out here."

241.speaker: Hugo Toras
241.text: "She certainly can. I'll stay right here."

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: Hugo looked at us both warily.

245.speaker: Narrator
245.text: Elena gave him a nod. The two of them headed towards the palace doors.

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: I watched them go inside. When I turned my attention back to Rusty, I saw him studying me intently.

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "Is there something you've been keeping from me?"

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "If the people want regulations, I'm not going to get in their way."

250.speaker: Russello Montoro
250.text: "I could ask you the same question."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "You're beginning to test my patience, Mr. Montoro."

252.speaker: Russello Montoro
252.text: "Wait, Your Majesty. You're going to want to hear this next part."

253.speaker: Russello Montoro
253.text: "I heard you're thinking of bringing some pretty big changes to Rizia."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "Yes, I'm planning changes. Changes that will keep people like you from hoarding wealth."

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: "I'm not going to dignify that with a response."

259.speaker: Russello Montoro
259.text: "But there's something else the people want more. Isn't there, Your Majesty?"

260.speaker: Narrator
260.text: He looked around to make sure all of our guards were out of earshot.

262.speaker: Russello Montoro
262.text: "People like me have bankrolled every major power shift since 1823. Arcasia, Qinal, Lespia... you name it, there's a fat wallet behind it."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "I am not opposed to working together. But I want it to be on my terms."

264.speaker: Russello Montoro
264.text: "This is just the beginning, Your Majesty."

265.speaker: Russello Montoro
265.text: "And if you really do want to pull the rug out from under the Rizian nobility, you're going to need the fattest wallet of all."

266.speaker: Russello Montoro
266.text: "You don't have to respond. Just hear me out for a second."

267.speaker: Russello Montoro
267.text: "All I know is, the word 'reform' has come up in connection with your name once or twice. And I don't mean the branch of Dastnurity."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "If I did have such plans in store, what business would it be of yours?"

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "The rumors are exaggerated. Any reforms I put in place will be minor at the very most."

274.speaker: Russello Montoro
274.text: "Minor or not, you know as well as I do that the nobility in this country doesn't take kindly to change."

275.speaker: Narrator
275.text: He triumphantly gestured at himself. On seeing Hugo striding back towards us, he adopted a more serious posture.

276.speaker: Russello Montoro
276.text: "You're going to need someone in your corner. Someone with resources to burn and no scruples about burning them."

277.speaker: Russello Montoro
277.text: "Just letting you know that I'm on your side. Or I could be, if you let me."

278.speaker: Russello Montoro
278.text: "I am so, so, sorry. You can take the guards out of Arcasia, but you can't... well, you know."

279.speaker: Russello Montoro
279.text: "Do you need an occasion to catch up with an old friend?"

280.speaker: Hugo Toras
280.text: "Since when are you worried about the Rizian People's Party, Mr. Montoro?"

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "He's right to be worried. With Manus Sazon in charge, the party could become a real threat."

282.speaker: Player_Romus
282.text: "His Grace is right. The RPP doesn't have the power to change anything."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "The party wants to bring the workers' demands to the highest level of government. Admirable."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "The miners don't need the RPP to help them. I'm the King. I can better their situation in an instant."

288.speaker: Russello Montoro
288.text: "Not if we steer them in the right direction."

291.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

292.speaker: Russello Montoro
292.text: "Better to focus on breaking new ground, if you ask me. That mining survey of yours was a good start..."

293.speaker: Russello Montoro
293.text: "Qalus, on the other hand, is looking *very* promising. That survey of yours was a stroke of genius."

297.speaker: Russello Montoro
297.text: "Better to focus on breaking new ground, if you ask me. Rumor has it your relatives in Valenqiris might be sitting on some *extremely* valuable real estate."

((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ConductMiningSurveys"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Completed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_QalusGoldMine_Project"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ConductMiningSurveys"] == true  and

298.speaker: Russello Montoro
298.text: "That said, the more unnecessary requirements we have to meet to extract that gold, the less of it you get to keep."

299.speaker: Russello Montoro
299.text: "Will they make anyone safer? Doubtful. Will they be a death blow to our bottom line? One hundred percent."

300.speaker: Player_Romus
300.text: "I still don't understand what you're getting at."

301.speaker: Russello Montoro
301.text: "If the rumors are true, Your Majesty... I see huge potential for both of us to win big."

302.speaker: Russello Montoro
302.text: "Hell, do you know how much growth we're missing out on because international investors don't want to mess with an absolute monarchy?"

303.speaker: Russello Montoro
303.text: "I'm on your side. Or I could be, if you let me."

304.speaker: Hugo Toras
304.text: "I take it as a positive sign that Mr. Montoro is open to renegotiating that stake. And I agree that over-regulation of our industries would hamper businesses while emboldening workers to a dangerous degree."

305.speaker: Narrator
305.text: He gave me a crooked smile.

306.speaker: Russello Montoro
306.text: "I know, Your Majesty. Every single day, I'm grateful for the privilege I've been given."

307.speaker: Russello Montoro
307.text: "I would like nothing more than to pay it forward. Let RRG keep running the way we always have, and I swear I'll return the favor in triplicate."

311.speaker: Russello Montoro
311.text: "My pal Gus Manger told me he saw potential in your reign. I'm inclined to agree with him."

312.speaker: Russello Montoro
312.text: "If you keep on making deals and let us run our business the way we always have... well, just imagine a gold swimming pool in every Rizian backyard."

313.speaker: Russello Montoro
313.text: "We're in this together. What's good for Rizian Royal Gold is good for Rizian royals. And vice versa."

314.speaker: Russello Montoro
314.text: "Just let us keep running things the way we always have, and we'll take care of the rest."

315.speaker: Hugo Toras
315.text: "I wouldn't have taken you for an art connoisseur. Mr. Montoro. That Kolores fresco in your hallway is stunning."

316.speaker: Narrator
316.text: He cut himself off upon seeing Hugo striding back towards us.

317.speaker: Russello Montoro
317.text: "Yeah, well. My pal Gus Manger convinced me it was a good investment."

320.speaker: Player_Romus
320.text: "I've heard enough. If I'd known you'd invited me here only to wheedle favors out of me, I would have saved myself the trip."

321.speaker: Russello Montoro
321.text: "Give me a hint, Your Majesty. Is the Crown on our side?"

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "We're indeed in this together. Keep supplying the kingdom with gold, and I will take care of any obstacles in RRG's way."

324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "The only side I'm on is that of ordinary, hard-working Rizians. I want what is best for them, even if our gold reserves suffer."

325.speaker: Russello Montoro
325.text: "If I'm wrong, go ahead and tell me to go to hell. All you nobles do, anyway."

327.speaker: Player_Romus
327.text: "I'd never utter such blasphemous words. But I'm not interested in discussing this with you."

334.speaker: Russello Montoro
334.text: "He told me he had very high hopes for your reign, by the way. Hopes that I myself share."

335.speaker: Russello Montoro
335.text: "He doesn't have any hard feelings about you turning down his deals, by the way. But he hopes you'll keep the door open."

336.speaker: Russello Montoro
336.text: "If you keep on making deals and let us run our business the way we always have... well, just imagine a gold swimming pool in every Rizian backyard."

338.speaker: Russello Montoro
338.text: "And so do I. Especially when it comes to that thing we were just discussing."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "I appreciate everything RRG has done for the Crown. But I owe it to the Rizian people to take the concerns of the workers into consideration."

340.speaker: Player_Romus
340.text: "I'm not going to make any promises one way or the other."

343.speaker: Russello Montoro
343.text: "Favors? I'm sorry if I gave you the wrong impression. This was only supposed to be a friendly chat."

346.speaker: Narrator
346.text: He gestured towards a number of floral-patterned chairs that had been set out on the terrace, overlooking the pool.

350.speaker: Russello Montoro
350.text: "And I didn't hear you complaining about my manners when you were accepting my money."

354.speaker: Russello Montoro
354.text: "Plus, y'know, you did accept a big chunk of change from me lately. Thought you might want to come meet your benefactor in person."

358.speaker: Russello Montoro
358.text: "By the way, no rush on paying back that loan I gave you."

359.speaker: Player_Romus
359.text: "Yes, thank you for your offer. You'll get your repayment in due time."

360.speaker: Player_Romus
360.text: "It's a disgrace that my father allowed you to accumulate so much wealth. The King of Rizia should not have to stoop to borrowing from a commoner."

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "Borrowing from RRG does not mean you and I are entering into any kind of *arrangement*. You should know that upfront."

362.speaker: Russello Montoro
362.text: "You're a valuable shareholder in my business, Your Majesty. You want our arrangement to stop there, it will."

363.speaker: Russello Montoro
363.text: "It was nothing. I know you and Ms. Werner will put the cash to good use."

364.speaker: Russello Montoro
364.text: "Hey, it's not like I didn't work for it. And besides, I know you and Ms. Werner will double that money in no time."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "It's impolite of you to bring that up here. We shall speak no more of it."

370.speaker: Player_Romus
370.text: "You say cooperation, I say usury. Did you try to pull that 'loan' trick with my father?"

371.speaker: Russello Montoro
371.text: "Trick, Your Majesty? I was only trying to give us both a leg up. You've got to spend money to make money, as I'm sure you know."

375.speaker: Russello Montoro
375.text: "And by the way. Should you ever find yourself low on Crown funds, don't hesitate to reach out."

376.speaker: Russello Montoro
376.text: "RRG aside, I've been fortunate enough to have made some very profitable investments. Happy to share the wealth."

377.speaker: Russello Montoro
377.text: "Don't get me wrong, Your Majesty -- my personal finances will be just fine. It's your revenue stream I'm looking out for here."

378.speaker: Russello Montoro
378.text: "And don't forget. You ever find yourself low on Crown funds again, the bank of Rusty is still open."

382.speaker: Russello Montoro
382.text: "Qalus, on the other hand, is looking *very* promising."
